title: „So viel Luft“ – Testimonial-Montage
format: UGC-style montage of several denture wearers (selfie / phone-on-a-stand look) + bright high-key product close-ups + two flat infographics. One female narrator (Character A) speaks the whole script – on camera in her own scenes, as voice-over everywhere else.
voice_note: Female VO, German, warm, calm, conversational (Character A). Address: Sie.
captions_note: Small captions (2–4 words at a time): white box, black bold sans, centered just below the middle. Header text where noted: dark translucent box, white bold capitals, top center.

shots.vo_line: Am nächsten Morgen kommt der Moment, auf den es wirklich ankommt. Sie greifen automatisch zur Tube – und die Prothese sitzt noch genauso fest wie am Abend davor,
shots.h3_prompt: Behind her on the right a white sink with a blue liquid-soap dispenser and toiletries, and a dark-framed mirror. She lowers her hand from her mouth, smiles and talks to the camera with natural lip movement, small nods and raised eyebrows; handheld selfie camera, slight natural sway. Her top keeps exactly the same rust-orange colour and the bathroom light stays the same for the whole clip. One continuous shot from this exact first frame; keep the same people, faces, clothing, setting, background, lighting and colours for the whole clip. No new people, no extra hands. No new objects appear: no tubes, boxes, packages, bottles or products that are not already in the first frame. No text, letters, numbers, labels, signs, captions or logos appear anywhere; anything plain stays plain and unbranded. Dentures, gums and teeth stay realistic and clean. Gentle natural motion, no morphing.
